description: Deliberately hard cases the heuristic detectors are expected to miss: an all-caps name, an abbreviated-initial name, an abbreviated month, and a building-name address with no recognized street-suffix keyword. Included so recall is measured honestly rather than assumed -- BUILD.md's own risk table expects imperfect recall on names/addresses.
